items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: Well, Milton and I became friends, very close friends

ctx.x: Yeah...we didn't talk about Mezz and all...

Well, Milton and I became friends, very close friends, when he came home from being away in the '40s. And I knew... we knew a lot of people. And Mezz and I had the concerts in Philadelphia, but I never judge a man by his skin or by...oh, he was once a prisoner, or, you know. As long as he treat me all right and / courteous to my friends, I accept him. So I gave Mezz every cent in Philadelphia...we made fifty bucks. That was enough to tide him over. In Philadelphia he played at the Academy of Music and when we…
So now Mezz and I became friends and he reciprocated--he found an angel who had money and he let me make those records
